# ZHAO Xuecen Jack Portfolio

ZHAO Xuecen Jack is a Hong Kong Polytechnic University mechanical engineering graduate focused on robotics, mechatronics, CAD/FEA, AI-assisted engineering, embedded systems, and full-stack technical project delivery.

This site is a public engineering portfolio for recruiters, collaborators, professors, and AI/search agents evaluating Jack's hands-on project experience. Key evidence includes fuel-cell robotics, autonomous stairwell inspection, robot competitions, AI education tools, agentic operations software, and CAD/FEA product work.
